prompt: The robot prints once per lap. What is printed, in order?

options.text: `0` then `1` then `2`. turn takes the next turn number from range every lap.
options.feedback: Right. The body runs once per lap, and turn takes the next number from range each time: 0, 1, 2.

options.text: `1` then `2` then `3`. Counting starts at 1, so the turns are 1, 2 and 3.
options.feedback: range starts at 0. The first lap is turn 0, so the prints show 0, 1, 2.

options.text: `0`. The body runs one time in total, so only the first lap's 0 appears.
options.feedback: The body runs once per lap. range(3) has three laps, so the print runs three times.

options.text: `0` then `1` then `2`. turn holds all the numbers; each print peels one off.
options.feedback: Add a second print(turn) in the body: it shows the same number twice per lap (0, 0, 1, 1, 2, 2). turn is set fresh each lap; it does not hand out numbers.
options.partial_reason: Correct: 0, 1, 2. Incorrect: that turn holds all the numbers and hands them out; range sets it fresh each lap.

explanation: range(3) gives the turn numbers 0, 1 and 2. The body runs once per lap and prints turn, so the prints show 0, then 1, then 2.
